description: Use when you need to summarize text such as an article, notes or a transcript into a short summary. Do not use for uRLs or PDFs (extract the text first), exact quotes or citations. Returns JSON with a concise summary of the plain text you send (up to 20,000 characters): one short paragraph and key bullet points, written by IBM Granite 4.0 Micro on Workers AI for 0.008 USDC per call. Typical response time 8000 ms (p95). Category: Inference. Price: US$0.008 per call. A small free demo credit covers the first calls; after that the tool returns the command that pays the call from your own wallet (AgentCash or Coinbase Agentic Wallet).

language.description: Language for the summary, e.g. English or Portuguese (default: the language of the text)

maxBullets.description: Most bullet points to return (1-10, default 5)

text.description: Plain text to summarize, e.g. an article or a transcript (80 to 20,000 characters)

name: blackwood_text_summarize
title: Summarize text
